name: Nursie
tagline: An on-site AI nurse assistant for long-term care that detects falls with radar and a floor mat and talks to residents.

awards: [MLH] Best Use of ElevenLabs // [MLH] Meilleure utilisation de ElevenLabs

problem: In Québec long-term care, unwitnessed night falls and staff shortages leave residents on the floor too long, the team says.
solution: mmWave radar and a vibration mat detect falls, door and presence sensors add context, a smartwatch tracks vitals, and a voice interface responds, all on a local network.
demo_moment: Team-described: simulate a fall and see the alert and voice check-in.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best Use of ElevenLabs // [MLH] Meilleure utilisation de ElevenLabs” among 260 submissions.
Uses sensing that does not rely on cameras.

lessons: Name the place and the failure (night falls in care homes) to make the stakes concrete.
